verdict.rationale: Cross-device copy and paste is a fair capability to ask of a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions clipboard sync, clipboard history across devices, or pairing with another device. The keyboard-shortcut and Snap layout items are adjacent features and do not show copying on one device and pasting on another.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can copy content on one device and paste it on another paired device
